decision.explanation: The question asks for the director of the film 'Baby Doll'. Source D1S1, D2S1, and D3S3 explicitly identify Elia Kazan as the director of the film 'Baby Doll' (specifically the 1956 black comedy based on Tennessee Williams' work). However, Source D4S1 states that 'La bambolona', which was internationally released as 'Baby Doll' (and 'Big Baby Doll'), is a 1968 Italian comedy film directed by Franco Giraldi. Since the prompt instructions state that 'Different artists can legitimately release works with an identical title' and to 'Keep supported alternate referents rather than one familiar winner', both Elia Kazan (director of the 1956 US film) and Franco Giraldi (director of the 1968 Italian film released under the same English title) are valid answers corresponding to distinct entities with the same title.
